file_roles.evidence: Adds the config KUBERNETES_ALLOCATION_DRIVER_READINESS_TIMEOUT (default 1s) used by the new wait; a knob needed by the real change.
start() now waits with waitUntilReady(driverPodReadinessTimeout) on the driver pod before subscribing to snapshots; follow-up commit fixes a None.get in that new code.

rationale: Executors started before the driver service was resolvable by DNS (UnknownHostException). The allocator owned the start order, and the diff adds the missing wait there.
notes: The follow-up None.get fix is a bug in the new code, not in the original failure.
